detail.title: Foundations of Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.summary: This revision integrates automated value system learning from observations and human demonstrations, showing how preference grounding functions can be inferred in sequential decision-making domains.

detail.title: Provisional Foundations of Autonomous Objectives

detail.reason: Establishing provisional synthesis for the unassigned objectives project.
